operations.name: tokens.create
operations.summary: Create a token (the secret is shown once).

operations.name: tokens.rotate
operations.summary: Rotate a token: new secret (shown once), old one revoked.

operations.name: projects.create
operations.summary: Create (and open) a project in the server's project store.

operations.name: projects.open
operations.summary: Open a project (the engine hosts one at a time).

operations.name: projects.summary
operations.summary: Revision, sequences, clips, assets and run counts.

operations.name: uploads.create
operations.summary: Stream a file into staging (raw body; Content-Length required).

operations.name: uploads.create_inline
operations.summary: Stage a small file sent as base64 (8 MiB max).

operations.name: assets.import
operations.summary: Import a staged upload through the asset system (hash + probe + catalog).

operations.name: sequences.get
operations.summary: One sequence (full content; use timeline.query for large ones).

operations.name: timeline.query
operations.summary: Clips of a sequence by time range, paginated, with a content digest.

operations.name: commands.preview
operations.summary: Phase 1 of the write gate: validate a transaction and get a plan token (nothing is written).

operations.name: commands.apply
operations.summary: Phase 2 of the write gate: apply only the reviewed plan.

operations.name: runs.create
operations.summary: Start an AI Run from brief + raw footage + references.

operations.name: runs.get
operations.summary: Run snapshot (stages, effects, provenance, pending decision).

operations.name: runs.approve
operations.summary: Answer the pending approval/decision of a run.

operations.name: runs.plan
operations.summary: Production plan, edit plans and validation of a run.

operations.name: runs.cost
operations.summary: Usage and budget of a run.

operations.name: runs.variants
operations.summary: Create variants from a completed run.

operations.name: memory.list
operations.summary: Project/client/user memory items (read-only: promotion is a UI action).

operations.name: exports.start
operations.summary: Queue exports of sequences (server chooses the output location).

operations.name: exports.cancel
operations.summary: Cancel the batch of an export.

operations.name: webhooks.create
operations.summary: Register a webhook (the signing secret is shown once).

operations.name: webhooks.delete
operations.summary: Delete a webhook and its delivery log.

operations.name: webhooks.deliveries
operations.summary: Delivery log (attempt, status, latency, next retry, terminal state).

operations.name: events.list
operations.summary: Server events after a cursor (polling; SSE at /v1/events/stream).
